notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective July 1, 1988, see section 6303 of Pub. L. 100–297, set out as an Effective Date of 1988 Amendment note under section 1071 of this title.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 98–511, title VI, § 601, Oct. 19, 1984, 98 Stat. 2401, provided that title VI of Pub. L. 98–511 was to be cited as the “Emergency Immigrant Education Act of 1984”, prior to repeal by Pub. L. 100–297, title I, § 1003(c), Apr. 28, 1988, 102 Stat. 293.
